notes: 1926 seven-storey narrow flats, 10.6 m front. Pale mint stucco, a barred raised base with a recessed teal-framed arched entry under a dark green canopy at centre-right, a small iron balcony at the second storey, a wide central cant bay from the third storey to the roof, plain double windows left and right, belt course and light cornice. Tint lift (2026-10-02): paint tints lifted toward the sunlit paint (t' = 1-(1-t)k); brick tints converted to target / kit colour. Pale mint wall cfe3c8 (was a near-white that rendered grey), dark green trim, ground band to the belt course. Round arched entry under the dark green awning and the left-of-bay fire escape are already in place; barred ground windows kept. Lifted/converted once to #e2f0de. GroundBand lift (2026-10-03): groundBand tint #d6dfcc -> #eaefe6 (same rule as walls; it was missed by the first colour pass).
